say:1:1121187001:0.text: Such strife, such ignorance! True aesthetics will never be drowned out by vulgarity, never...
say:1:1121187001:0.source_cn: 如此挣扎，如此愚昧！真正的美学绝不会被庸俗淹没，绝不会……

say:2:1121187002:0.text: Let these miserable, vile creations of the gods languish a little longer, for there will come a day when true art will flourish across the land—by my hand!
say:2:1121187002:0.source_cn: 就让粗俗丑恶的神明造物再苟延残喘一阵子吧，总有一日，真...

say:10:1121187004:1.text: Archon Talene, that Hypogean... will he ever return?
say:10:1121187004:1.source_cn: 塔琳殿下，那个恶魔……他还会回来吗？

say:11:1121187005:1.text: Fear not. I will hunt him to the edge of the world if I must, and he will face the justice he deserves.
say:11:1121187005:1.source_cn: 不必担心。我会追击他，让他接受裁决，付出应有的代价。

say:12:1121187006:1.text: Such is the duty of a Celestial.

choice_prompt:14:1121187006.text: Such is the duty of a Celestial.

say:15:1121187007:1.text: Yes, I must. There is no time to delay.
say:15:1121187007:1.source_cn: 我得尽快动身，不能耽搁。

say:16:1121187008:1.text: You also have your own mission to shoulder... I feel it will be an arduous journey.
say:16:1121187008:1.source_cn: 你也有自己肩负的使命……我想，那必将是一段艰险的旅程吧。
say:16:1121187008:1.male: You also have your own mission to shoulder... I feel it will be an arduous journey.
say:16:1121187008:1.female: You also have your own mission to shoulder... I feel it will be an arduous journey.

say:17:1121187009:1.text: Perhaps you have forgotten certain things now, but memories and forgetfulness are both trials and gifts bestowed by Dura.
say:17:1121187009:1.source_cn: 现在的你或许忘却了一些东西，但是，回忆与遗忘，都是艾雅...
say:17:1121187009:1.male: Perhaps you have forgotten certain things now, but memories and forgetfulness are both trials and gifts bestowed by Dura.
say:17:1121187009:1.female: Perhaps you have forgotten certain things now, but memories and forgetfulness are both trials and gifts bestowed by Dura.

say:18:1121187010:1.text: If it wasn't for my amnesia, how would I have met you all and forged such friendships?
say:18:1121187010:1.source_cn: 如果不是这一次的失忆，我又怎么能认识你们，结下这样的友谊呢？

say:19:1121187011:1.text: Let us part here, and look forward to meeting under brighter circumstances.
say:19:1121187011:1.source_cn: 所以，我们就在此分别吧，为了下一次相遇。

say:20:1121187012:1.text: Farewell, and may your paths be guided by the light and warmth of the sun!
say:20:1121187012:1.source_cn: 再会，愿你们今后的旅途洒满阳光，永远温暖明亮！

narration:27:1101021182:0.text: Talene bids you farewell and sets out once more on her quest against the Hypogeans.
narration:27:1101021182:0.source_cn: 塔琳与你们告别后，再次踏上追逐对抗恶魔的旅程。

narration:28:1101021181:0.text: Reinier uses spatial magic and vanishes right before you.
narration:28:1101021181:0.source_cn: 恶魔雷内亚使用空间法术，在你们面前消失了。
